title: The Johannine Comma (the Three Heavenly Witnesses)
aka: three that bear record in heaven
lead: The words "in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one" in the KJV's 1 John 5:7-8 are found in no Greek manuscript before the 1300s and in none of the oldest translations except the Latin. They entered the Latin Bible in late antiquity, printed Greek New Testaments in the Complutensian Polyglot (printed 1514, published 1520-1521) and Erasmus' third edition (1522) and the KJV in 1611, and left the main text of most modern Bibles after 1881. This page tells that history.
